question: Câu 601: Our approach towards the proposal ______ rather cautious because of several failures that we have experienced lately.
explanation: Chủ ngữ “Our approach” là danh từ số ít → động từ chia số ít is.

question: Câu 602: Corruption in the police force is rampant, but authorities are turning a ______ eye.
explanation: turn a blind eye: vờ như không thấy, nhắm mắt làm ngơ.

question: Câu 603: The government's choice for the new Defense Secretary seemed pretty ______ to the opposition party.
explanation: far-fetched: rất khó tin, khó có thể là sự thật.

question: Câu 604: The first thing I saw in the morning ______ Henry's van parked in front of the museum. I didn't like it at all, as Henry ______ to be away for another week or so.
explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít → was – was.

question: Câu 605: Guide dogs open up the lives of the blind or ________ impaired.
explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho impaired → visually.

question: Câu 606: The social media is so ______ in our daily lives that it is hard to imagine living without using it.
explanation: intervened: can thiệp vào.

question: Câu 607: The goal is to make higher education available to everyone who is willing and capable ______ his financial situation.
explanation: regardless of: bất kể.

question: Câu 608: When you use the Internet, you have so much information at your ______.
explanation: have something at your fingertips: có thông tin sẵn sàng, dễ dàng sử dụng.

question: Câu 609: My friend bought ________ from a shop on Tran Phu street.
explanation: Trật tự tính từ OSASCOMP: nice (O) – brown (C) – leather (M).

question: Câu 610: In the United States, ________ approximately four million miles of roads, streets, and highways.
explanation: There + be + N: có cái gì.

question: Câu 611: Population growth is not in the exclusive control of a few governments, but rather in the hands of hundreds of millions of individual parents.
explanation: exclusive (duy nhất, dành riêng) >< unrestricted (không bị hạn chế).

question: Câu 612: Strictly ________ the record, his work is not up to scratch. Don't tell him.
explanation: off the record: không chính thức, không được ghi nhận.

question: Câu 613: If you want to keep your job here, you must abide on our rules.
explanation: Sửa abide on → abide by (tuân theo).

question: Câu 614: While in my heart I can see myself wandering enchanted through China's Forbidden City, in my head I know I would be standing ________ at the back of a group listening to some Imperial Palace Tour Guide.
explanation: grumpily: một cách gắt gỏng, khó chịu.

question: Câu 615: Mark: “Why did you bring up this subject all of a sudden?” Hoa: “_________”
options: I had a hunch about it.
It was just a simple thought.
explanation: It just occurred to me: Nó vừa nảy ra trong đầu mình.

question: Câu 616: Hung: “Vietnam beat Thailand by four goals to nil in the match.” Quan: “_________. Their victory is worthy.”
options: It's weird that you care for football
explanation: Vietnamese footballers played so splendidly phù hợp ngữ cảnh.

question: Câu 617: “Mr. Adams is going to retire next month.” “________”
options: Right, you'd probably be the next.
explanation: You don't say!: thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên / nuối tiếc.

question: Câu 618: Jennifer: “I’m giving a presentation on global warming on Friday and I’m so nervous.” Mary: “_________.”
options: You should think more about how to present the subject matter effectively
There are a lot of things you can do to make you feel more confident
It is easier to convince the audience and to hold their attention with actual data
In order for you to succeed, you need to keep the audience interested and involved
explanation: There are a lot of things you can do to make you feel more confident là phản hồi khuyến khích phù hợp.

question: Câu 619: a. That's a great idea! We could also bring some board games to play. b. Yes, and maybe we can make some hot chocolate and popcorn to enjoy. c. How about having a cozy movie night at home this weekend? d. I think that would be a fun and relaxing way to spend the evening.
explanation: Thứ tự logic: c → d → b → a.

question: Câu 620: a. Is it usually quiet there? b. Do you know where I can find a quiet place to study? c. The library has a study room on the third floor. d. Yes, it's pretty peaceful. Just make sure to get there early to grab a spot.
explanation: Thứ tự logic: b → c → a → d.

question: Câu 621: a. That sounds interesting! I've never tried it before. What do I need to get started? b. I'm really into painting. It's a great way to unwind and be creative. c. Just some basic tools, seeds, and a bit of patience. It's really rewarding. d. I've been thinking about picking up a new hobby. Any suggestions? e. I'll look into it. What about you? What's your favorite hobby? f. How about gardening? It's relaxing and you can grow your own plants.
options: d – e – b – f – a – c
d – f – e – b – a – c
d – a – c – e – b – f
d – f – a – c – e – b
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d – f – a – c – e – b.

question: Câu 622: a. Can I have you, sir? b. What about getting another book, called “Pure love” by Josh Vance? c. Thank you. But I think I will go to another store. d. I am looking for a new book by James Park, called “The wise man”. e. Oh. I need the book now. I hope to buy it as a present for my friend. f. Sorry. That book has already sold out, but we have more on order already. They should be here next week.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a-d-f-e-b-c.

question: Câu 623: The country is rapidly losing its workers as ________.
options: people emigrating are more and more
more and more people are emigrating
explanation: more and more + N: ngày càng nhiều.

question: Câu 624: The 1665 plague in London took almost ______ lives ______ the Great Fire of London the year after.
explanation: as many + N + as: so sánh bằng với danh từ đếm được.

question: Câu 625: The people ______ called yesterday want to buy the house.
explanation: who làm chủ ngữ thay thế cho people.

question: Câu 626: Justice is often personified as a blindfolded woman to hold a pair of scales.
explanation: Sửa to hold → holding (rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động).

question: Câu 627: I accepted the new job after all. It is making me feel exhausted.
options: If it had not been for my acceptance the new job offer, I wouldn't have felt exhausted.
Perhaps it would have been better if I hadn't agreed to this new job since it is so boring.
It is of deep regret that I didn't turn down the job offer due to its hardship and long hour work.
Perhaps I shouldn't have accepted this new job, as it's making me feel exhausted.
explanation: Perhaps I shouldn't have accepted... diễn đạt sự hối tiếc phù hợp.

question: Câu 628: He spent all his money. He even borrowed some from me.
options: Not only did he spent all his money but also he borrowed some from me.
Hardly had he borrowed some money from me when he spent it all.
Not only did he spend all his money but he borrowed some from me as well.
As soon as he borrowed some money from me, he spent it all.
explanation: Not only + trợ động từ + S + V nguyên thể + but ... as well.

question: Câu 629: Could you reply this e-mail? Please confirm your attendance at the meeting!
options: I wonder whether you have the ability to confirm your attendance at the meeting.
If I were you I would reply this e-mail to confirm my attendance at the meeting.
Do you mind replying this e-mail to confirm your attendance at the meeting?
You'd better reply this e-mail to confirm your attendance at the meeting soon.
explanation: Do you mind + V-ing: bạn có phiền làm gì không (lịch sự).

question: Câu 630: I had just arrived home. I was called immediately back to the head office nearly 10 kilometers away.
options: Hardly had I arrived home when I was called immediately back to the head office nearly 10 kilometers away.
Because I had just arrived home, I was called immediately back to the head office nearly 10 kilometers away.
Should I had just arrived home, I was called immediately back to the head office nearly 10 kilometers away.
Whenever I had just arrived home, I was called immediately back to the head office nearly 10 kilometers away.
explanation: Hardly had + S + P2 + when + S + V: ngay sau khi ... thì ...

question: Câu 631: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is a regional development bank ____ in 1966 to promote economic growth, social development, and regional cooperation in Asia and the Pacific.
explanation: Quá khứ phân từ rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: established.

question: Câu 632: ADB provides financial support, technical assistance, and policy advice to its member countries, with a focus on reducing poverty and ____ sustainable, inclusive development.
explanation: fostering: thúc đẩy, nuôi dưỡng.

question: Câu 633: ____, such as infrastructure, education, healthcare, environmental protection, and urban development.
options: Developing countries need to borrow money for investments
Some projects are not funded by the bank
There are many changes in Asia
explanation: Its projects span diverse sectors phù hợp ngữ cảnh liệt kê các lĩnh vực.

question: Câu 634: In recent years, ADB has ____ green and resilient growth, pledging billions of dollars to support renewable energy, climate adaptation, and sustainable urbanization across the region.
explanation: pioneered: tiên phong.

question: Câu 635: With 68 member countries, including both regional and non-regional members, ADB plays a critical role in ____ to tackle Asia's evolving challenges and promote long-term, equitable prosperity.
explanation: mobilizing resources and expertise: huy động nguồn lực và chuyên môn.

question: Câu 636: What does the passage mainly discuss?
options: Study on what effects music has on cheese makers.
Types of music played in cheese factories.
A research on how music influences cheese quality.
An experiment carried out to find out what cheese musicians prefer.
explanation: Bài đọc nói về nghiên cứu ảnh hưởng của âm nhạc đến chất lượng phô mai.

question: Câu 637: According to the passage, what was true about the mentioned research?
options: It was conducted in a 6-week time.
A top swiss cheese maker and a factory led the experiment.
It concluded that cheese played hip-hop tasted and smelt better than others.
It discovered a usual link between music and cheese.
explanation: Cheese played hip-hop had a stronger aroma and flavor.

question: Câu 638: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “look into” as used in the passage?
options: test whether something is true or not
find out the truth about something
explanation: look into: điều tra, tìm hiểu sự thật.

question: Câu 639: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “cheese aficionados” as used in the passage?
options: people who know a lot about something
people who love cheese and related products
people who like listening to music when eating cheese
people who are knowledgeable about music
explanation: cheese aficionados: những người yêu thích phô mai.

question: Câu 640: According to the passage, what created the taste of cheese?
explanation: Bacteria are responsible for the formation of the taste of cheese.

question: Câu 641: What is the passage mainly about?
options: History of cities all over the world
Types of cities in the world
Contributions of cities to the world
explanation: Bài đọc nói về sự đóng góp và vai trò ngày càng lớn của các thành phố.

question: Câu 642: Which of the following is NOT true according to the writer?
options: Humanity transitioned from a rural to a primarily urban species at breathtaking speed.
Cities are the dominant form of human civilization in the 21st century.
There is a tendency for cities to connect to form large urban regions.
People should not be too optimistic about the future of cities.
explanation: Tác giả thể hiện sự lạc quan về tương lai của các thành phố.

question: Câu 643: The phrase "flex their muscles" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ____.
explanation: flex their muscles: thể hiện sức mạnh.

question: Câu 644: Would the following sentence best be placed at the end of which paragraph? - “This is neither fair nor rational.”
explanation: Câu này phù hợp kết thúc đoạn 1 về việc quốc gia vẫn chi phối dù thành phố đã thay đổi lớn.

question: Câu 645: The word “they” in paragraph 4 refers to ________.
explanation: they = cities (Cities channel creativity... they drive growth).

question: Câu 646: Which of the following situations best exemplifies “caution” where someone takes care in order to avoid danger or mistakes?
options: James misses the deadlines which he is assigned to complete in 2 days. He apologizes and assures me that he will fulfill the task as soon as possible.
James takes on the role of team leader in a new project. He makes a plan, conducts thorough research, and assigns tasks to team members before running the project.
James refuses to undertake new tasks because he will take a holiday.
James joins a new project team to work with many experts from other companies. He tries his best to cooperate with them but nobody cares about him.
explanation: Lập kế hoạch và nghiên cứu kỹ lưỡng thể hiện sự thận trọng.

question: Câu 647: You’ve noticed that every time someone walks past a particular table, the glasses on the table shake slightly. What is the likely cause?
options: The glasses are not positioned properly.
The table is wobbly and needs adjustment.
The floor is slippery near the table.
explanation: Bàn lỏng gây rung khi có người đi qua.

question: Câu 648: A study was done on the weights of different types of fish in a pond. A random sample of fish were caught and marked in order to ensure that none were weighed more than once. The sample contained 150 largemouth bass, of which 30% weighed more than 2 pounds. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the sample data?
options: The majority of all fish in the pond weigh less than 2 pounds.
The average weight of all fish in the pond is approximately 2 pounds.
Approximately 30% of all fish in the pond weigh more than 2 pounds.
Approximately 30% of all largemouth bass in the pond weigh more than 2 pounds.
explanation: Dữ liệu chỉ áp dụng cho largemouth bass trong mẫu.

question: Câu 649: James: Would you like to go out for dinner tonight with me? You: ____.
options: I know a good restaurant downtown. Let's go there.
You are welcome. That's just a small thing.
Congratulation! You really deserve the invitation.
Thanks, but I'm not hungry right now.
explanation: Gợi ý nhà hàng là phản hồi tích cực phù hợp với lời mời.

question: Câu 650: Which of the following situations best exemplifies “profit”?
options: Alex bought vintage furniture for 50 dollars and resold it for 150 dollars, earning 100 dollars above the original purchase price.
In order to thank Jamie for her hard work, Sarah, the manager, rewarded her with 1000 dollars as a bonus, recognizing her dedication and outstanding performance throughout the year.
Lisa spent 200 dollars on supplies to make jewelry, which she sold for 200 dollars, covering her costs but earning no extra money.

Tom ordered a new camera online. When he received it, it turned out to be an old one. He asked for a refund, and the store sent him back the full amount he had paid for the camera, which was 1000 dollars.
explanation: Lợi nhuận là số tiền kiếm được khi bán cao hơn giá mua.
